d:
I decided to completely redo the old one since I wasn't satisfied at all with how it came out previously, I felt that I didn't do nearly enough and the goon stuff wasn't even fleshed out so I felt bad having realized I came up short with it and figured I can add more scenes to make it proper.

I sorta redid it, comics like these can take me a couple days if I hard lock in on a weekend or something.

Don't worry all the other comics I have in mind are going to come out soon since I've been a bit more diligent when trying to practice. I hope you follow my other stuff! Have a good one.
